mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market that boosts wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause S&P 500 underperformance, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year window exceeds -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year window exceeds -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong consumer demand that drives corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS grows, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.03.
